title: What is Chat GPT? And What Does It Have to Do with Assistive Technology?
main_claim: Chat GPT is a game-changing AI technology that can be used to assist people with disabilities, particularly those with visual impairments.
summary: Chat GPT is an AI chatbot technology developed by Open AI that can process human language and generate responses.
It can be used for various tasks, including answering questions, explaining complex concepts, and generating text or images.
The latest version of GPT, GPT 4, can process images and create designs, but has limitations such as generating incorrect information or biased content.
Chat GPT has been integrated with assistive technologies like Be My Eyes and Envision AI to provide virtual assistance for people with visual impairments.
The integration of Chat GPT with assistive technologies has the potential to revolutionize access to information and services for people with vision loss.
